その名を、新しく迎える誰かへ渡さなかった。リオラは盾を横へずらす。空欄のまま、結: I did not give that name to someone we might welcome. Liora moved her shield aside. A path appeared where we could walk past the ward with the space still empty.
第7章・10。契印を守る石の残響が、帰路を塞いだ。私たちは誰かを生むことを約束す: Chapter 7, Route 10. A stone-echo guarding the covenant seal blocked our return. We faced it not to promise we would create someone, but to leave a way to stop together and return together.
契印を守る石の残響が、帰路を塞いだ。私たちは誰かを生むことを約束するためではなく: A stone-echo guarding the covenant seal blocked our return. We faced it not to promise we would create someone, but to leave a way to stop together and return together.
結界は静まり、石は布の中に残った。今日は迎える儀式を進めない。二人でそう決め、帰: The ward fell quiet, and the stone remained wrapped. We would not proceed with the welcoming ritual today. Having chosen that together, we signed the return column. Ruka handed us her night-mending thread and agreed to join the next journey.
イオネが筆を置くと、待っていた少女はようやく顔を上げた。\n名を問われるより前に:
When Ione set her pen down, the waiting woman finally looked up.
Before being asked her name, she said she wanted to see no one tonight.
分かりました。名前を言わないまま休める場所があるか、先に聞いてきます。\nここに:
I understand. I will ask first whether there is somewhere you can rest without giving your name.
May I write down that you are here?
少女は、少し考えてから頷いた。リオラは入口へ立ち、迎えに来た者を待たせていた。\:
The woman thought for a moment, then nodded. Liora stood at the entrance, keeping the escort waiting.
"She is speaking. Later." Those few words protected the blank on the page.
私の名も、庭園の女に聞かれる前は、ただの空欄だったのかもしれない。\n私は返答を:
Perhaps, before the woman in the garden had asked for it, my name had been only an empty space, too.
I sat in the neighboring chair without hurrying an answer.
フィオが薬布の棚へ、小さな札を結んだ。\n誰のために残したか、本人に聞いたか。分:

Who had the parcel been kept for? Had she been asked? The uncertain bundles went onto a separate shelf, still marked as uncertain.
全部、私が持っていれば安心だと思ってた。\nでも、それだと、私が眠ったら誰にも見:

札には、次に届ける場所と、戻ってくる時刻がある。\n私の分は、ここへ戻すことにし:

この薬布があれば、同行の支度はできるよ。\nギルドで声をかけて。ひとりで全部運ぶ:
These supplies are enough for me to prepare for the journey.
Ask for me at the Guild. I would rather have someone to talk to on the way home than carry it all alone.
帰りたいとは、まだ言っていない: She Has Not Said She Wants to Return

この記録が、助けた人もいると思う。\nだから捨てない。でも、今の返事を、昔の字の:

So I will not throw it away. But I do not want today's answer hidden beneath the old writing.
リオラが、庭園へ出す報告を折り直した。\n私はその字を、もう所有者へ戻す印とは思:

I no longer saw that writing as a mark for returning someone to an owner. The place she wished to return to belonged to her answer, too.
「今夜の宛先」を、隣へ書いた。\n書き終えても、筆は返せるところに置いておいた。:
I wrote tonight's address beside it.
When I finished, I left the pen where it could be handed back.

"Eat before you stand watch." I accepted the half she offered.
長く立てるのが、偉いわけじゃないんだ。\n次へ渡すまで倒れないこと。その次は、自:

いない人と、休んでいる人を、同じ空欄にすると困るの。\n戻るまでの間を、誰かが覚:

あの方への気持ちは、私が引き受ける。\nおまえに、同じものを望んではいない。:

誰かが、急いで縫ってくれたところだ。\nまだ、ほどきたくない。:

「明日には」じゃなく、今、止めるんだね。\nそう言うと、リオラは一度だけ頷いた。:
"Not tomorrow. We stop now."
Liora nodded once.
